class: A check that decides 'is X running right now?' from the presence of a marker file is wrong whenever the writer does not reliably delete the marker: it reports X running long after X ended, and every block or wait built on it stalls for the full staleness window.
mechanism: The kit verifier write-guard writes a snapshot at a verifier's PreToolUse and deletes it at PostToolUse; measured 2026-10-17 00:25, 70 snapshots from the last 24 h were still on disk (5 from the PR #337 reviewer that had finished minutes earlier). The project's verifier_inflight_gate hook (PR #335) treats any snapshot younger than 15 minutes as 'a verifier call is in flight', so after a verifier run it refused the orchestrator's `git add` (snapshot 170 s old) with no verifier running.

first_seen.where: GC-2a docs batch, main session, 00:25 IST
first_seen.evidence: refusal: 'BLOCKED by verifier_inflight_gate: `git add` is not on the read-only list. A verifier tool call is running (snapshot 170s old)'; `ls verifier-write-guard/snap` -> 70 files dated 2026-10-16 01:29 .. 2026-10-17 00:25; only a builder agent was running

fix: Open. Options for GC-2b: (a) shorten the window to the longest single verifier tool call (measure it first); (b) treat a snapshot as live only while its verifier agent runs (needs the agent's start/stop, e.g. a SubagentStart/Stop marker written by a project hook and owned by session, run-discipline D2); (c) a kit fix so the guard always deletes its snapshot (PostToolUseFailure, refused calls) - kit issue. Until then the refusal text names the file to delete; delete only after confirming no verifier agent is running.

detection.note: Seen only as a false refusal. A detection would count snapshots older than the window at session start.

occurrences.where: GC-2a, first use of the hook after PR #335 merged
occurrences.evidence: 5 snapshots written 00:25 by the finished #337 reviewer; deleted by hand after confirming only a builder was running

occurrences.where: GC-2b, recording W-081 evidence after its verifier finished (03:00 IST)
occurrences.evidence: record_evidence_fp.py refused: 'A verifier tool call is running (snapshot 363s old)'; only builder agents were running; the finished verifier's last (refused) cleanup call left one snapshot. Second occurrence: each verifier run that ends on a refused call leaves one.
